readings.subject: va.deminimis — paragraph 28 VA de-minimis trigger
readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The selected VA de-minimis trigger applies to a paragraph 28 fund manager if the fund either has a stated objective to invest in AMLO virtual assets or intends to invest at least 10% of GAV in those assets, excluding Tokenised Securities. False means only that this selected trigger does not apply; unknown inputs remain unknown where they prevent determination.
readings.distinction: The objective limb independently triggers application even below 10%; the allocation limb includes exactly 10%. Tokenised Securities alone satisfy neither limb. Requiring both limbs, counting Tokenised Securities, or imposing an additional actual-holdings condition would lack support under the selected interface. No materially different second reading is supported. The strongest unresolved issue is supplying the legal classifications and investment-intention evidence, not the disjunctive threshold.

citations.quote: the “de minimis threshold”7 under the Terms and Conditions only applies to virtual assets as defined in section 53ZRA of the AMLO.

the SFC would not impose the Terms and Conditions on fund managers managing portfolios investing in Tokenised Securities meeting the “de minimis threshold” unless the portfolios also invest in virtual assets meeting the “de minimis threshold”.

“de minimis threshold” refers to the situation where either: (a) the stated investment objective of a fund is to invest in virtual assets or (b) the intention of a fund is to invest 10% or more of its gross asset value (GAV) in virtual assets.

Fund managers managing portfolios which may invest in Tokenised Securities are nevertheless reminded that they should comply with the requirements set out in this circular when the portfolios they manage invest in Tokenised Securities.

Paragraph 28 excludes Tokenised Securities from this VA threshold calculation; it does not exempt a mixed portfolio whose VA objective or intended VA allocation satisfies footnote 7. Paragraph 29 preserves separate tokenisation duties.

The selected result determines whether the stated trigger applies. Paragraph 28's statement about non-imposition of the Terms and Conditions is not permission to disregard other requirements or proof of compliance with those Terms and Conditions.

The assessment uses the frozen provision and the stated objective or intended investment, rather than adding an actual-holdings test. No operative assessment date, measurement cadence or later amendment is supplied. The 2019 date concerns the superseded Statement.

Paragraph 28 relies on footnote 7, the Joint circular, the Terms and Conditions and AMLO section 53ZRA. The external instruments are not reproduced in full; legal classification and actor scope therefore remain judgment-bearing inputs. Other cross-references govern separate controls.

readings.subject: va.deminimis — paragraph 28 and footnote 7 trigger for one fund mandate
readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The selected VA de-minimis trigger applies to a fund manager within paragraph 28 if either the fund's stated objective is to invest in qualifying virtual assets or its intended qualifying VA investment is at least 1000 basis points of GAV. Tokenised Securities do not count toward either VA condition. A false result means only that this selected trigger does not apply.
readings.distinction: One supported reading is proposed. The objective limb can trigger even below 10% intended VA exposure; the quantitative limb includes exactly 10% and does not require a stated VA objective. Requiring both limbs, counting Tokenised Securities, or adding an actual-holdings condition would lose express qualifiers. The strongest remaining uncertainty concerns supplying the professional classifications and mandate evidence, rather than the disjunction.

“de minimis threshold” refers to the situation where either: (a) the stated investment objective of a fund is to invest in virtual assets or (b) the intention of a fund is to invest 10% or more of its gross asset value (GAV) in virtual assets.

normative.0.rationale: Conditional on the supplied classifications, the formula preserves both independent limbs: a stated VA investment objective OR intended VA investment of at least 1000 basis points, exactly 10% of GAV. It correctly includes the threshold boundary, uses intention rather than actual holdings, excludes Tokenised Securities from the VA inputs, and limits evaluation to classified paragraph 28 fund managers. The supplied circular adds no further condition to this selected trigger; its other obligations remain separate, including paragraph 29. The uncertainty and conflict rules are declared runtime conventions, not additional substantive legal tests.

controlled-language.0.rationale: The executable meaning correctly preserves the source’s OR structure: either the stated investment objective is to invest in qualifying AMLO virtual assets, or the intention is to invest at least 10% of GAV in those virtual assets. The 1,000-basis-point boundary is exactly 10%, and the GAV denominator is correct. The formula appropriately scopes the question to fund managers and excludes Tokenised Securities from the qualifying virtual-asset conditions, consistent with paragraph 28’s distinction. It adds no holdings requirement or other tests. The conclusion remains conditional on the supplied classifications and runtime uncertainty rules.
